connection.noTools: No tools found for this MCP server

logo.label: Logo
logo.tooltip: Select a well-known logo or paste a URL to any image. The logo is shown on the admin and chat pages.
logo.customUrlPlaceholder: Or paste a custom logo URL...

import.title: Import MCP Connectors
import.description: Paste an Anthropic connector configuration: the mcpServers mapping from a Claude Desktop / Claude Code config file, or the mcp_servers array from the Anthropic Messages API.
import.requestFailed: Import request failed. Check the proxy logs for details.

form.submissionNotice: Your submission will be sent for admin review. Once approved, the server will appear in your MCP Servers list. The request must be made with a team-scoped API key.

serverName.label: MCP Server Name
serverName.tooltip: Best practice: Use a descriptive name that indicates the server's purpose (e.g., 'GitHub_MCP', 'Email_Service'). Cannot contain spaces or hyphens; use underscores instead. Names must comply with SEP-986 and will be rejected if invalid (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/tools#tool-names).

form.aliasTooltip: A short, unique identifier for this server. Defaults to the server name if not provided. Cannot contain spaces or hyphens; use underscores instead.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Brief description of what this server does

openapiSpecUrl.label: OpenAPI Spec URL
openapiSpecUrl.tooltip: URL to an OpenAPI specification (JSON or YAML). MCP tools will be automatically generated from the API endpoints defined in the spec.
openapiSpecUrl.required: Please enter an OpenAPI spec URL

maxConcurrent.label: Max Concurrent Requests (optional)
maxConcurrent.tooltip: Maximum number of tool calls LiteLLM will run against this server at the same time. Additional calls wait for a free slot. Leave blank for no limit.

authValue.label: Authentication Value
authValue.tooltip: Token, password, or header value to send with each request for the selected auth type.
authValue.whitespaceCreate: Authentication value cannot be empty whitespace
authValue.placeholderEdit: Enter token or secret (leave blank to keep existing)

stdio.heading: Configure the stdio transport used to launch the MCP server process. You can either fill in the fields below or paste a JSON configuration.
stdio.commandRequired: Please enter a command for stdio transport
stdio.envJsonNotObject: Env must be a JSON object
stdio.configTooltip: Paste your stdio MCP server configuration in JSON format. You can use the full mcpServers structure from config.yaml or just the inner server configuration.

aws.heading: For MCP servers hosted on AWS Bedrock AgentCore.

region.label: AWS Region
region.tooltip: AWS region for SigV4 signing (e.g., us-east-1)

serviceName.label: AWS Service Name
serviceName.tooltip: AWS service name for SigV4 signing. Defaults to 'bedrock-agentcore'.

accessKeyId.label: AWS Access Key ID
accessKeyId.tooltip: Optional. If not provided, falls back to the boto3 credential chain (IAM role, env vars, etc.).

secretAccessKey.label: AWS Secret Access Key
secretAccessKey.tooltip: Optional. Required if AWS Access Key ID is provided.

sessionToken.label: AWS Session Token
sessionToken.tooltip: Optional. Only needed for temporary STS credentials.

roleArn.label: AWS Role ARN
roleArn.tooltip: Optional. IAM role ARN to assume via STS before signing. If set, LiteLLM calls sts:AssumeRole to get temporary credentials.

sessionName.label: AWS Session Name
sessionName.tooltip: Optional. Session name for the AssumeRole call — appears in CloudTrail logs. Auto-generated if omitted.

oauthFlowMissing.title: This server has no OAuth flow set
oauthFlowMissing.description: Choose Machine-to-Machine (M2M) or Interactive (PKCE) so LiteLLM authenticates it the way you intend, then save. Until it is set, LiteLLM falls back to interactive per-user auth and treats a machine-to-machine credential shape conservatively.

payloadErrors.invalidToolDisplayName: Tool display name "{{displayName}}" is invalid. Only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens are allowed (no spaces).
payloadErrors.invalidTokenValidationJson: Invalid JSON in Token Validation Rules
payloadErrors.stdioMissingCommand: Stdio configuration must include a command
payloadErrors.invalidStdioEnvJson: Invalid JSON in stdio env configuration

validation.url: Please enter a valid URL (e.g., http://service-name.domain:1234/path or https://example.com)
validation.serverName: Cannot contain '-' (hyphen) or spaces. Please use '_' (underscore) instead.

toast.tokenHeldPreview: Token held for this browser session. Tools can now be previewed and configured; the token is not saved to LiteLLM.
toast.tokenHeldLoad: Token held for this browser session. Tools can now be loaded and configured; the token is not saved to LiteLLM.
toast.oauthAuthorizedCreate: OAuth authorization successful! Please click 'Create MCP Server' to save the configuration.
toast.oauthAuthorizedEdit: OAuth authorization successful! Please click 'Update MCP Server' to save the credentials.
toast.submitted: MCP Server submitted for admin review
toast.submittedDescription: Once an admin approves it, the server will appear in your MCP Servers list.
toast.tokenPersistFailed: MCP Server updated, but failed to persist OAuth token
toast.tokenPersistFailedWithMessage: MCP Server updated, but failed to persist OAuth token: {{message}}

loadTools.incompleteFallback: Complete the URL, authentication, and header settings to load tools.
loadTools.authorizeUpstream: Authorize with the upstream (browser-only, in the Authentication section) to load and configure this server's tools.
loadTools.authenticateToolsTab: Authenticate with this server in the Tools tab to load and configure its tools.

network.privateRangesDescription: Define which IP ranges are part of your private network. Callers from these IPs can see all MCP servers. Callers from any other IP can only see servers marked "Available on Public Internet".
network.rangeHint: Enter CIDR ranges (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8). When empty, standard private IP ranges are used.
